title: What Operations Teams Build With AI: Custom Tools That Replace $50K/Year in SaaS
summary: 6 things operations teams build with AI instead of buying more SaaS — vendor trackers, KPI dashboards, onboarding systems, and more. No per-seat fees.
body_markdown: Airtable and Notion are general-purpose tools — flexible but not specific to your process. You configure them to approximate what you need. A custom-built tool does exactly what your process requires from day one. The Airtable Business plan runs $45/seat/month; a Blink-built tool has no per-seat cost. For a team of 6, that's $270/month vs. $0/month in ongoing per-seat fees — with a one-time build cost of a few hours.
